mapper.sql: id, user_id, monthly_amount, pay_day, delay_days, modify_count, last_modify_month, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM income_config WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO income_config (user_id, monthly_amount, pay_day, delay_days, modify_count, last_modify_month, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{monthlyAmount}, #{payDay}, #{delayDays}, #{modifyCount}, #{lastModifyMonth}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE income_config SET monthly_amount = #{monthlyAmount}, pay_day = #{payDay}, delay_days = #{delayDays}, modify_count = #{modifyCount}, last_modify_month = #{lastModifyMonth}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE income_config SET modify_count = 0, last_modify_month = #{month}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
